name: Motion Verse
role: Co-founder of KR8 Digitals · Media Director · Graphic Design
blurb: Motion Verse teaches graphic design to KR8 students for free, and leads brand and graphic work for KR8 clients.
long: Stevenson runs Motion Verse, a creative studio turning raw ideas into brand-ready visuals. He is a co-founder of KR8 Digitals and leads the Graphic Design track in the Academy — the same discipline he sells commercially, taught by the person who does it for a living.
contribution: Graphic design teaching · brand and identity delivery

record.what: Graphic Design track lead across Academy cohorts
Brand identity and social suite for City Fashion Stores
Flyer and advert design system for Abakaliki High School's Presco Trip

name: Chigoma
role: Co-founder of KR8 Digitals · COO · Video Editing & Animation
blurb: Chigoma teaches video editing to KR8 students for free — from raw footage to finished, scroll-stopping cuts.
long: Daniel, known as Creative Expression, runs Chigoma and heads Video Editing & Animation at KR8 Digitals. He teaches students to edit with intention rather than software familiarity: why a cut lands, why a hook holds, why the first two seconds decide the rest.
contribution: Video editing teaching · motion and post-production

record.what: Video Editing track lead across Academy cohorts
Commercial motion breakdown published to the KR8 gallery
Teaching contributor, credited on student certificate work

name: Next Gen Scholars
blurb: Next Gen Scholars prepares students for JAMB, WAEC and the subject choices that decide what they can study — chemistry and the sciences taught properly.
long: Next Gen Scholars is KR8's academic partner: the second door of Free Training. Where the Academy teaches creative and technical craft, Next Gen Scholars prepares students for the examinations that gate university admission, and helps them choose science or arts subjects with their eyes open.

record.what: Academic track established inside Free Training

long: HIS Battle Axe (Dance Crew) appear on the live KR8 site as a trusted collaborator — part of the cultural programme around Tribe and Mindset Shift events rather than a teaching partnership.
